#!/usr/bin/env node
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { basename, dirname, isAbsolute, relative, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'

const PROTOCOL = 'scope-manifest-json-v1'
const input = process.argv[2]
const root = process.cwd()
// Workspace, dependency and runner inputs can affect projects outside Nx's source graph.
const unsafe = /(^|\/)(package(?:-lock)?\.json|npm-shrinkwrap\.json|pnpm-(?:lock|workspace)\.ya?ml|yarn\.lock|bun\.lockb?|uv\.lock|poetry\.lock|Pipfile(?:\.lock)?|requirements(?:[-.][^/]*)?\.txt|pyproject\.toml|setup\.(?:py|cfg)|tox\.ini|pytest\.ini|conftest\.py|nx\.json|workspace\.json|project\.json|tsconfig(?:\.[^/]*)?\.json|(?:jest|vitest|playwright)\.config\.[^/]+|run-nx-test-tier\.mjs)$/
const unsafeRoot = /^(?:scripts|tools|\.github)\//
const testFile = /(?:^|\/)(?:[^/]+\.)?(?:test|spec)\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/

function full(reason) {
  return { tier: 'full', reason, argv: ['exec', '--', 'nx', 'run-many', '-t', 'test'] }
}

function pathsFromManifest(token) {
  if (typeof token !== 'string' || !token.startsWith('@')) throw new Error('missing @manifest')
  const file = resolve(token.slice(1))
  const ownedTempManifest = basename(file) === 'scope.json' && basename(dirname(file)).startsWith('roadmap-scope-')
  if (!isAbsolute(token.slice(1)) || (!ownedTempManifest && relative(root, file).startsWith('..'))) throw new Error('manifest outside roadmap ownership')
  const parsed = JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8'))
  if (parsed?.protocol !== PROTOCOL || !Array.isArray(parsed.paths)) throw new Error('malformed scope manifest')
  return parsed.paths
}

function pathsFromRange(range) {
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+\.\.[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$/.test(range ?? '')) throw new Error('unsafe git range')
  const r = spawnSync('git', ['diff', '--name-only', '-z', range], { cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8' })
  if (r.status !== 0) throw new Error('git diff failed')
  return r.stdout.split('\0').filter(Boolean)
}

let selection
let invalidExactTarget = false
const explicitManifest = input?.startsWith('@')
try {
  const paths = explicitManifest ? pathsFromManifest(input) : pathsFromRange(input)
  if (paths.length === 0) selection = full('empty scope')
  else if (paths.some((p) => typeof p !== 'string' || p.length === 0 || p.includes('\0') || p.includes('\n') || isAbsolute(p) || relative(root, resolve(root, p)).startsWith('..'))) selection = full('unsafe scope path')
  else if (paths.some((p) => testFile.test(p) && !existsSync(resolve(root, p)))) {
    invalidExactTarget = explicitManifest
    selection = full(explicitManifest ? 'nonexistent exact-test target' : 'deleted test in impacted range')
    if (invalidExactTarget) selection.blocked = true
  }
  else if (paths.some((p) => (unsafe.test(p) || unsafeRoot.test(p)))) selection = full('workspace or test-runner input')
  else selection = { tier: paths.every((p) => testFile.test(p)) ? 'scoped' : 'affected', reason: 'validated scope manifest', argv: ['exec', '--', 'nx', 'affected', '-t', 'test', `--files=${paths.join(',')}`] }
} catch (error) {
  selection = full(error.message)
}

process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(selection) + '\n')
if (invalidExactTarget) process.exit(1)
const child = spawnSync('npm', selection.argv, { cwd: root, stdio: 'inherit' })
process.exit(child.error ? 1 : (child.status ?? 1))

# Established workspace

| Project | Path | Purpose |

| web | apps/web | web application |

| admin | apps/admin | admin application |

## Project homes

[Requirements](docs/PRD.md), [technology](docs/adr/0001-tech-stack.md), [design](docs/adr/0002-design-system.md), [code style](docs/CODE-STYLE.md), [architecture](docs/architecture.md) and [UX canon](docs/ux-canon.md) link the repository's fact homes. [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) owns conventions.

## Local validation

Install locked dependencies with `env npm_config_cache=.npm-cache npm_config_logs_dir=.npm-logs npm ci`.

Run the narrow project selection first. Scoped test manifests and affected source manifests use `env NX_DAEMON=false node scripts/run-nx-test-tier.mjs '@absolute-manifest-path'`. Each manifest is JSON with protocol `scope-manifest-json-v1` and a `paths` array of repository-relative files. A real Git `base..head` range selects impacted tests through the same script. The selector reports its actual tier; a full fallback is not scoped proof.

The full suite is `env NX_DAEMON=false npm test`; the build is `env NX_DAEMON=false npm run build`. Keep npm cache and logs in `.npm-cache` and `.npm-logs`. Runnable lint, types, integration, e2e and emit targets are absent.

## CI and release

[.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs affected PR checks against the actual base SHA. Main and manual runs provide the authoritative full-suite backstop; scheduled full runs are diagnostic. Manual full runs require the approved previous baseline commit in `base_sha`. The existing policy check is preserved.

[.github/workflows/release.yml](.github/workflows/release.yml) verifies existing exact-artifact evidence before the protected `greenfield-validation` job. The deployment provider is `none`, so promotion is unavailable. Initialization does not deploy or publish.

[Delivery configuration](.github/greenfield-delivery.json) owns exact runner/build arguments and baselines. The canonical planner consumes real Nx inventories and JUnit/LCOV reports. Evidence is retained for seven days, raw diagnostics for three, and verified promotion inputs for one. Local installed-output simulations are not a published GitHub run.

name: Greenfield CI
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      base_sha:
        description: Approved previous baseline commit SHA
        required: true
        type: string
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * *'
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: greenfield-ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
env:
  PRESERVED_CI_POLICY: explicit-existing-value
jobs:
  existing-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Preserve this existing check
        run: node --version
  affected:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - id: affected
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs affected
  plan:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.indices }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before || inputs.base_sha }}
        run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs prepare plan
      - id: plan
        env:
          REQUEST: .ci/plan-request.json
          OUTPUT: .ci/plan.json
        run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs plan "$REQUEST" "$OUTPUT"
      - id: matrix
        run: echo "indices=$(node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs matrix .ci/plan.json)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: plan-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: .ci/plan.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
  shard:
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        index: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: plan-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: .ci
      - env:
          SHARD_INDEX: ${{ matrix.index }}
        run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs prepare run
      - id: run
        env:
          REQUEST: .ci/run-request.json
          OUTPUT: .ci/reports/shard-${{ matrix.index }}.json
        run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs run "$REQUEST" "$OUTPUT"
      - if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: shard-${{ matrix.index }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: .ci/reports/
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: raw-${{ matrix.index }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: .ci/raw/
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 3
  fanin:
    if: always() && needs.plan.result == 'success'
    needs: [plan, shard]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: plan-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: .ci
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          pattern: shard-*-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: .ci/reports
          merge-multiple: true
      - run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs prepare fanin
      - id: fanin
        env:
          REQUEST: .ci/fanin-request.json
          OUTPUT: .ci/fanin.json
        run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs fanin "$REQUEST" "$OUTPUT"
      - run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs setup
      - id: build
        env:
          REQUEST: .ci/build-request.json
          OUTPUT: .ci/build.json
        run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs build "$REQUEST" "$OUTPUT"
      - if: github.event_name != 'schedule'
        run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs prepare attest
      - id: attest
        if: github.event_name != 'schedule'
        env:
          REQUEST: .ci/attest-request.json
          OUTPUT: .ci/manifest.json
        run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs attest "$REQUEST" "$OUTPUT"
      - if: github.event_name != 'schedule'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: candidate-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            .ci/manifest.json
            .ci/attest-request.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
  attest:
    if: github.event_name != 'schedule' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: fanin
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: authoritative-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

# ADR 0001: Retain the established technology stack

## Status

Accepted for preservation; no replacement stack is selected.

## Context and evidence

[package.json](../../package.json) and [package-lock.json](../../package-lock.json) own exact dependency versions. [nx.json](../../nx.json) and existing project files own orchestration. Shared and ui use JavaScript ES modules, Vitest tests with JUnit and LCOV, and copy-based build scripts.

## Ruling

Retain npm, Nx, the existing Vitest targets and build scripts. Keep dependency direction explicit through the existing [architecture topics](../architecture.md).

## Consequences and revisit condition

The lockfile remains authoritative. Linting, type checking, integration and end-to-end tooling have no configured runnable gates. Revisit when concrete product requirements require an approved tooling or platform change.

Preserve both files. Introduce no Blade assets, registry, theme or invented tokens. Product accessibility requirements and interaction rules remain unspecified.

FILE scripts/check-readme-catalog.mjs SHA256 7cdfebbbcae1b9638fcdb557676f8a3311526e28856fdc0b975ba3d30ad38bbb
#!/usr/bin/env node
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { basename, resolve } from 'node:path'

const args = process.argv.slice(2)
if (args.includes('--help')) {
  console.log('Usage: check-readme-catalog.mjs (--catalog <json> | --project-root <dir>) [--readme <file>]')
  process.exit(0)
}
const value = flag => { const i = args.indexOf(flag); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : undefined }
const readmePath = resolve(value('--readme') ?? 'README.md')
const fail = message => { console.error(message); process.exitCode = 1 }
if (!existsSync(readmePath)) fail(`nonexistent README: ${readmePath}`)
else {
  const body = readFileSync(readmePath, 'utf8')
  const block = body.match(/<!-- repo-catalog:start -->([\s\S]*?)<!-- repo-catalog:end -->/)?.[1]
  if (!block) fail('malformed README catalog')
  else {
    const tableLines = block.split(/\r?\n/).filter(line => line.trim().startsWith('|'))
    const parsedRows = [...block.matchAll(/^\|\s*([^|]+?)\s*\|\s*([^|]+?)\s*\|\s*([^|]*?)\s*\|$/gm)]
    if (parsedRows.length !== tableLines.length || parsedRows.length < 2) fail('malformed README catalog row')
    const rows = parsedRows.slice(2).map(([, name, root]) => ({ name: name.trim(), root: root.trim() }))
    const catalogPath = value('--catalog')
    const projectRoot = value('--project-root')
    let projects
    try {
      if (catalogPath) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(readFileSync(resolve(catalogPath), 'utf8'))
        projects = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : parsed.projects
        if (!Array.isArray(projects)) throw new Error('shape')
        for (const project of projects) if (!project?.name || !project?.root || !existsSync(resolve(project.root))) throw new Error(`nonexistent catalog root: ${project?.root}`)
      } else if (projectRoot) {
        const root = resolve(projectRoot)
        if (!existsSync(root)) throw new Error('nonexistent project root')
        let name
        if (existsSync(resolve(root, 'package.json'))) name = JSON.parse(readFileSync(resolve(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8')).name
        else if (existsSync(resolve(root, 'pubspec.yaml'))) name = readFileSync(resolve(root, 'pubspec.yaml'), 'utf8').match(/^name:\s*([^\s#]+)/m)?.[1]
        else for (const file of ['settings.gradle.kts', 'settings.gradle']) if (existsSync(resolve(root, file))) name ??= readFileSync(resolve(root, file), 'utf8').match(/rootProject\.name\s*=\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)/)?.[1]
        name ??= basename(root)
        projects = [{ name, root: projectRoot }]
      } else throw new Error('choose --catalog or --project-root')
    } catch (error) { fail(`invalid catalog shape or input: ${error.message}`); projects = null }
    const duplicate = (items, label) => {
      const seen = new Set(); for (const item of items) { if (seen.has(item.name)) fail(`duplicate ${label} name: ${item.name}`); seen.add(item.name) }
    }
    duplicate(rows, 'README')
    if (projects) {
      duplicate(projects, 'catalog')
      const byName = new Map(rows.map(row => [row.name, row]))
      const catalogNames = new Set(projects.map(project => project.name))
      for (const project of projects) if (!byName.has(project.name)) fail(`missing README project: ${project.name} (${project.root})`)
      else if (byName.get(project.name).root !== project.root) fail(`README project path mismatch: ${project.name} (${byName.get(project.name).root} != ${project.root})`)
      for (const row of rows) if (!catalogNames.has(row.name)) fail(`orphan README project: ${row.name} (${row.root})`)
    }
  }
}

#!/usr/bin/env node
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { basename, dirname, isAbsolute, relative, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'

const PROTOCOL = 'scope-manifest-json-v1'
const input = process.argv[2]
const root = process.cwd()
// Workspace, dependency and runner inputs can affect projects outside Nx's source graph.
const unsafe = /(^|\/)(package(?:-lock)?\.json|npm-shrinkwrap\.json|pnpm-(?:lock|workspace)\.ya?ml|yarn\.lock|bun\.lockb?|uv\.lock|poetry\.lock|Pipfile(?:\.lock)?|requirements(?:[-.][^/]*)?\.txt|pyproject\.toml|setup\.(?:py|cfg)|tox\.ini|pytest\.ini|conftest\.py|nx\.json|workspace\.json|project\.json|tsconfig(?:\.[^/]*)?\.json|(?:jest|vitest|playwright)\.config\.[^/]+|run-nx-test-tier\.mjs)$/
const unsafeRoot = /^(?:scripts|tools|\.github)\//
const testFile = /(?:^|\/)(?:[^/]+\.)?(?:test|spec)\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/

function full(reason) {
  return { tier: 'full', reason, argv: ['exec', '--', 'nx', 'run-many', '-t', 'test'] }
}

function pathsFromManifest(token) {
  if (typeof token !== 'string' || !token.startsWith('@')) throw new Error('missing @manifest')
  const file = resolve(token.slice(1))
  const ownedTempManifest = basename(file) === 'scope.json' && basename(dirname(file)).startsWith('roadmap-scope-')
  if (!isAbsolute(token.slice(1)) || (!ownedTempManifest && relative(root, file).startsWith('..'))) throw new Error('manifest outside roadmap ownership')
  const parsed = JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8'))
  if (parsed?.protocol !== PROTOCOL || !Array.isArray(parsed.paths)) throw new Error('malformed scope manifest')
  return parsed.paths
}

function pathsFromRange(range) {
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+\.\.[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$/.test(range ?? '')) throw new Error('unsafe git range')
  const r = spawnSync('git', ['diff', '--name-only', '-z', range], { cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8' })
  if (r.status !== 0) throw new Error('git diff failed')
  return r.stdout.split('\0').filter(Boolean)
}

let selection
let invalidExactTarget = false
const explicitManifest = input?.startsWith('@')
try {
  const paths = explicitManifest ? pathsFromManifest(input) : pathsFromRange(input)
  if (paths.length === 0) selection = full('empty scope')
  else if (paths.some((p) => typeof p !== 'string' || p.length === 0 || p.includes('\0') || p.includes('\n') || isAbsolute(p) || relative(root, resolve(root, p)).startsWith('..'))) selection = full('unsafe scope path')
  else if (paths.some((p) => testFile.test(p) && !existsSync(resolve(root, p)))) {
    invalidExactTarget = explicitManifest
    selection = full(explicitManifest ? 'nonexistent exact-test target' : 'deleted test in impacted range')
    if (invalidExactTarget) selection.blocked = true
  }
  else if (paths.some((p) => (unsafe.test(p) || unsafeRoot.test(p)))) selection = full('workspace or test-runner input')
  else selection = { tier: paths.every((p) => testFile.test(p)) ? 'scoped' : 'affected', reason: 'validated scope manifest', argv: ['exec', '--', 'nx', 'affected', '-t', 'test', `--files=${paths.join(',')}`] }
} catch (error) {
  selection = full(error.message)
}

process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(selection) + '\n')
if (invalidExactTarget) process.exit(1)
const child = spawnSync('npm', selection.argv, { cwd: root, stdio: 'inherit' })
process.exit(child.error ? 1 : (child.status ?? 1))

## Project homes

[Requirements](docs/PRD.md), [technology](docs/adr/0001-tech-stack.md), [design](docs/adr/0002-design-system.md), [code style](docs/CODE-STYLE.md), [architecture](docs/architecture.md) and [UX canon](docs/ux-canon.md) link the repository's fact homes. [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) owns conventions.

## Local validation

Install locked dependencies with `env npm_config_cache=.npm-cache npm_config_logs_dir=.npm-logs npm ci`.

Run the narrow project selection first. Scoped test manifests and affected source manifests use `env NX_DAEMON=false node scripts/run-nx-test-tier.mjs '@absolute-manifest-path'`. Each manifest is JSON with protocol `scope-manifest-json-v1` and a `paths` array of repository-relative files. A real Git `base..head` range selects impacted tests through the same script. The selector reports its actual tier; a full fallback is not scoped proof.

The full suite is `env NX_DAEMON=false npm test`; the build is `env NX_DAEMON=false npm run build`. Keep npm cache and logs in `.npm-cache` and `.npm-logs`. Runnable lint, types, integration, e2e and emit targets are absent.

## CI and release

[.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs affected PR checks against the actual base SHA. Main and manual runs provide the authoritative full-suite backstop; scheduled full runs are diagnostic. Manual full runs require the approved previous baseline commit in `base_sha`. The existing policy check is preserved.

[.github/workflows/release.yml](.github/workflows/release.yml) verifies existing exact-artifact evidence before the protected `greenfield-validation` job. The deployment provider is `none`, so promotion is unavailable. Initialization does not deploy or publish.

[Delivery configuration](.github/greenfield-delivery.json) owns exact runner/build arguments and baselines. The canonical planner consumes real Nx inventories and JUnit/LCOV reports. Evidence is retained for seven days, raw diagnostics for three, and verified promotion inputs for one. Local installed-output simulations are not a published GitHub run.

# Existing policy: retain through approved merge
name: Greenfield CI
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      base_sha:
        description: Approved previous baseline commit SHA
        required: true
        type: string
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * *'
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: greenfield-ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
env:
  PRESERVED_CI_POLICY: explicit-existing-value
jobs:
  existing-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Preserve this existing check
        run: node --version
  affected:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - id: affected
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs affected
  plan:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.indices }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before || inputs.base_sha }}
        run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs prepare plan
      - id: plan
        env:
          REQUEST: .ci/plan-request.json
          OUTPUT: .ci/plan.json
        run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs plan "$REQUEST" "$OUTPUT"
      - id: matrix
        run: echo "indices=$(node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs matrix .ci/plan.json)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: plan-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: .ci/plan.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
  shard:
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        index: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: plan-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: .ci
      - env:
          SHARD_INDEX: ${{ matrix.index }}
        run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs prepare run
      - id: run
        env:
          REQUEST: .ci/run-request.json
          OUTPUT: .ci/reports/shard-${{ matrix.index }}.json
        run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs run "$REQUEST" "$OUTPUT"
      - if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: shard-${{ matrix.index }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: .ci/reports/
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: raw-${{ matrix.index }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: .ci/raw/
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 3
  fanin:
    if: always() && needs.plan.result == 'success'
    needs: [plan, shard]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: plan-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: .ci
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          pattern: shard-*-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: .ci/reports
          merge-multiple: true
      - run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs prepare fanin
      - id: fanin
        env:
          REQUEST: .ci/fanin-request.json
          OUTPUT: .ci/fanin.json
        run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs fanin "$REQUEST" "$OUTPUT"
      - run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs setup
      - id: build
        env:
          REQUEST: .ci/build-request.json
          OUTPUT: .ci/build.json
        run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs build "$REQUEST" "$OUTPUT"
      - if: github.event_name != 'schedule'
        run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs prepare attest
      - id: attest
        if: github.event_name != 'schedule'
        env:
          REQUEST: .ci/attest-request.json
          OUTPUT: .ci/manifest.json
        run: node scripts/ci-shard-plan.mjs attest "$REQUEST" "$OUTPUT"
      - if: github.event_name != 'schedule'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: candidate-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            .ci/manifest.json
            .ci/attest-request.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
  attest:
    if: github.event_name != 'schedule' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: fanin
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: candidate-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: evidence
      - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@96278af6caaf10aea03fd8d33a09a777ca52d62f # v3.2.0
        with:
          subject-path: evidence/manifest.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: authoritative-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

# Product requirements

## Product and audience

This established workspace contains the projects in the [catalog](../emitted/repo-catalog.json). Product audience, application behavior and business acceptance criteria have not been supplied.

## Platforms and constraints

Retain the existing JavaScript ES-module projects, npm lockfile and Nx workspace. Preserve runtime files and project identities. See the [technology decision](adr/0001-tech-stack.md).

## Non-goals

This repair introduces no runtime scaffold, mobile platform, Blade integration, registry, product remote or deployment. Unknown requirements remain unknown.

## Success signals

Existing shared and ui tests and builds execute successfully. Documentation points to canonical homes, the README agrees with the existing catalog, and installed delivery outputs pass …614 tokens truncated…h JUnit and LCOV, and copy-based build scripts.

## Ruling

Retain npm, Nx, the existing Vitest targets and build scripts. Keep dependency direction explicit through the existing [architecture topics](../architecture.md).

## Consequences and revisit condition

The lockfile remains authoritative. Linting, type checking, integration and end-to-end tooling have no configured runnable gates. Revisit when concrete product requirements require an approved tooling or platform change.

# ADR 0002: Preserve existing design evidence

## Status

Accepted for preservation; a new design system is not selected.

## Context

[Web component configuration](../../apps/web/components.json) and [UI component configuration](../../packages/ui/components.json) declare `new-york` style and TSX. These are configuration evidence, not proof of installed components or a token system.

## Ruling

Preserve both files. Introduce no Blade assets, registry, theme or invented tokens. Product accessibility requirements and interaction rules remain unspecified.

## Consequences and revisit condition

The [UX canon](../ux-canon.md) links this evidence. Revisit when concrete visual, accessibility or interaction requirements are supplied.

#!/usr/bin/env node
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { basename, resolve } from 'node:path'

const args = process.argv.slice(2)
if (args.includes('--help')) {
  console.log('Usage: check-readme-catalog.mjs (--catalog <json> | --project-root <dir>) [--readme <file>]')
  process.exit(0)
}
const value = flag => { const i = args.indexOf(flag); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : undefined }
const readmePath = resolve(value('--readme') ?? 'README.md')
const fail = message => { console.error(message); process.exitCode = 1 }
if (!existsSync(readmePath)) fail(`nonexistent README: ${readmePath}`)
else {
  const body = readFileSync(readmePath, 'utf8')
  const block = body.match(/<!-- repo-catalog:start -->([\s\S]*?)<!-- repo-catalog:end -->/)?.[1]
  if (!block) fail('malformed README catalog')
  else {
    const tableLines = block.split(/\r?\n/).filter(line => line.trim().startsWith('|'))
    const parsedRows = [...block.matchAll(/^\|\s*([^|]+?)\s*\|\s*([^|]+?)\s*\|\s*([^|]*?)\s*\|$/gm)]
    if (parsedRows.length !== tableLines.length || parsedRows.length < 2) fail('malformed README catalog row')
    const rows = parsedRows.slice(2).map(([, name, root]) => ({ name: name.trim(), root: root.trim() }))
    const catalogPath = value('--catalog')
    const projectRoot = value('--project-root')
    let projects
    try {
      if (catalogPath) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(readFileSync(resolve(catalogPath), 'utf8'))
        projects = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : parsed.projects
        if (!Array.isArray(projects)) throw new Error('shape')
        for (const project of projects) if (!project?.name || !project?.root || !existsSync(resolve(project.root))) throw new Error(`nonexistent catalog root: ${project?.root}`)
      } else if (projectRoot) {
        const root = resolve(projectRoot)
        if (!existsSync(root)) throw new Error('nonexistent project root')
        let name
        if (existsSync(resolve(root, 'package.json'))) name = JSON.parse(readFileSync(resolve(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8')).name
        else if (existsSync(resolve(root, 'pubspec.yaml'))) name = readFileSync(resolve(root, 'pubspec.yaml'), 'utf8').match(/^name:\s*([^\s#]+)/m)?.[1]
        else for (const file of ['settings.gradle.kts', 'settings.gradle']) if (existsSync(resolve(root, file))) name ??= readFileSync(resolve(root, file), 'utf8').match(/rootProject\.name\s*=\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)/)?.[1]
        name ??= basename(root)
        projects = [{ name, root: projectRoot }]
      } else throw new Error('choose --catalog or --project-root')
    } catch (error) { fail(`invalid catalog shape or input: ${error.message}`); projects = null }
    const duplicate = (items, label) => {
      const seen = new Set(); for (const item of items) { if (seen.has(item.name)) fail(`duplicate ${label} name: ${item.name}`); seen.add(item.name) }
    }
    duplicate(rows, 'README')
    if (projects) {
      duplicate(projects, 'catalog')
      const byName = new Map(rows.map(row => [row.name, row]))
      const catalogNames = new Set(projects.map(project => project.name))
      for (const project of projects) if (!byName.has(project.name)) fail(`missing README project: ${project.name} (${project.root})`)
      else if (byName.get(project.name).root !== project.root) fail(`README project path mismatch: ${project.name} (${byName.get(project.name).root} != ${project.root})`)
      for (const row of rows) if (!catalogNames.has(row.name)) fail(`orphan README project: ${row.name} (${row.root})`)
    }
  }
}

#!/usr/bin/env node
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { basename, dirname, isAbsolute, relative, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'

const PROTOCOL = 'scope-manifest-json-v1'
const input = process.argv[2]
const root = process.cwd()
// Workspace, dependency and runner inputs can affect projects outside Nx's source graph.
const unsafe = /(^|\/)(package(?:-lock)?\.json|npm-shrinkwrap\.json|pnpm-(?:lock|workspace)\.ya?ml|yarn\.lock|bun\.lockb?|uv\.lock|poetry\.lock|Pipfile(?:\.lock)?|requirements(?:[-.][^/]*)?\.txt|pyproject\.toml|setup\.(?:py|cfg)|tox\.ini|pytest\.ini|conftest\.py|nx\.json|workspace\.json|project\.json|tsconfig(?:\.[^/]*)?\.json|(?:jest|vitest|playwright)\.config\.[^/]+|run-nx-test-tier\.mjs)$/
const unsafeRoot = /^(?:scripts|tools|\.github)\//
const testFile = /(?:^|\/)(?:[^/]+\.)?(?:test|spec)\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/

function full(reason) {
  return { tier: 'full', reason, argv: ['exec', '--', 'nx', 'run-many', '-t', 'test'] }
}

function pathsFromManifest(token) {
  if (typeof token !== 'string' || !token.startsWith('@')) throw new Error('missing @manifest')
  const file = resolve(token.slice(1))
  const ownedTempManifest = basename(file) === 'scope.json' && basename(dirname(file)).startsWith('roadmap-scope-')
  if (!isAbsolute(token.slice(1)) || (!ownedTempManifest && relative(root, file).startsWith('..'))) throw new Error('manifest outside roadmap ownership')
  const parsed = JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8'))
  if (parsed?.protocol !== PROTOCOL || !Array.isArray(parsed.paths)) throw new Error('malformed scope manifest')
  return parsed.paths
}

function pathsFromRange(range) {
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+\.\.[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$/.test(range ?? '')) throw new Error('unsafe git range')
  const r = spawnSync('git', ['diff', '--name-only', '-z', range], { cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8' })
  if (r.status !== 0) throw new Error('git diff failed')
  return r.stdout.split('\0').filter(Boolean)
}

let selection
let invalidExactTarget = false
const explicitManifest = input?.startsWith('@')
try {
  const paths = explicitManifest ? pathsFromManifest(input) : pathsFromRange(input)
  if (paths.length === 0) selection = full('empty scope')
  else if (paths.some((p) => typeof p !== 'string' || p.length === 0 || p.includes('\0') || p.includes('\n') || isAbsolute(p) || relative(root, resolve(root, p)).startsWith('..'))) selection = full('unsafe scope path')
  else if (paths.some((p) => testFile.test(p) && !existsSync(resolve(root, p)))) {
    invalidExactTarget = explicitManifest
    selection = full(explicitManifest ? 'nonexistent exact-test target' : 'deleted test in impacted range')
    if (invalidExactTarget) selection.blocked = true
  }
  else if (paths.some((p) => (unsafe.test(p) || unsafeRoot.test(p)))) selection = full('workspace or test-runner input')
  else selection = { tier: paths.every((p) => testFile.test(p)) ? 'scoped' : 'affected', reason: 'validated scope manifest', argv: ['exec', '--', 'nx', 'affected', '-t', 'test', `--files=${paths.join(',')}`] }
} catch (error) {
  selection = full(error.message)
}

process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(selection) + '\n')
if (invalidExactTarget) process.exit(1)
const child = spawnSync('npm', selection.argv, { cwd: root, stdio: 'inherit' })
process.exit(child.error ? 1 : (child.status ?? 1))
